body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Universal Electronics announced the upcoming launch of the new ‘NevoS70’ universal controller during CES 2008.
The newest flagship product in the critically acclaimed Nevo line brings unmatched ease of use and intuitive simplicity in a beautiful industrial design.

NevoS70 is a universal controller that intuitively delivers total control of entertainment and digital media devices in today's connected home as well as access to online information and web services. With an elegant one-handed design and a brilliant 3.5 inch color touch screen, it can be personalized for every user in the home.

Combined with the industry's largest professionally maintained infrared (IR) database, NevoS70 offers the widest array of features of any remote in its class. In addition to the rich array of features, everyone in the home will admire the sleek design of NevoS70 as it blends into both modern and traditional décor.

With NevoS70, consumers have a single control point to manage virtually all their home theater and stereo equipment while accessing digital content stored on the PC or media server. NevoS70 is capable of interacting with web-servers via widely adopted technologies in order to provide a rich user experience.

It can be programmed to interact with web sites to display content based on standard IP browsing technologies such as HTML, Flash and more, directly on the NevoS70 touch screen. By connecting NevoS70 to the home network via WiFi, users can check the latest sports scores from a preset website on the NevoS70 screen while enjoying their favorite game on the TV without interruption.

NevoS70 can be set up to compliment the home theater experience with content optimized for CE devices. Content like financial information, online TV guides, sports updates, traffic and much more can be easily accessed on the NevoS70.

When paired with a NevoConnect NC-50 base station, NevoS70 provides non-line of site IR control, serial device control and power sensing for efficient macro programming and control. NevoS70 communication is based on industry standards - WiFi, UPnP and Z-Wave - to ensure compatibility with a wide range of devices in home entertainment, control, and networking.

"The timing couldn't be better for the launch of NevoS70," says Paul Arling, chairman and chief executive officer of Universal Electronics. "With the continuing digital convergence in the home, consumers need a product that is easy to operate and easy to use with their home digital entertainment networks. NevoS70 delivers a host of new features that are sure to make it a favorite of home enthusiasts and custom installers alike."
NevoS70 is slated to begin shipping in early 2008 with an MSRP of 1,199(USD).
